profiles.description: Reusable coding image: machine0 loaded profile + OmO Native (omo) + DeepSeek Harness (dsh) + Hermes/OpenCode + devenv + polyglot toolchain
profiles.note: The builder's disk size becomes the image's minimum VM size, so a `large` builder (80 GB) means project VMs must be `large` or bigger — medium (60 GB) does not fit. Rebuild with --size medium if you only ever need small VMs.
